title: VoiceNoNG: High-Quality Speech Editing Model without Hallucinations

contributions.purpose: 解释为什么基于神经编解码语言模型(NCLM, 如 VoiceCraft)的语音编辑模型有更高的词错误率(WER), 从而定位质量瓶颈
contributions.mechanism: 对 VoiceCraft 输出做错误分析, 将高 WER 归因于注意力错误(幻觉)导致模型难以准确跟随目标转写文本
contributions.evaluation: 在 RealEdit 数据集上用 Whisper-large-v3 计算 WER, VoiceCraft(330M) 总 WER 5.23% / VoiceCraft(830M) 5.52%, 均高于所有 flow-matching 方法; 附录 Table 4/5 给出重复词、漏词等幻觉实例
contributions.domain: 语音编辑 / 语音合成
contributions.source_quote: We identify the **hallucination-like** problem in the autoregressive-based VoiceCraft model, which makes it difficult to follow the target transcription accurately. This leads to a higher word error rate (WER), calculated by comparing the transcribed text to the target transcription.

contributions.purpose: 构建一个既保持高语音质量又避免幻觉问题的语音编辑模型
contributions.mechanism: VoiceNoNG 结合 Voicebox 与 VoiceCraft: 用 latent flow-matching 框架建模神经编解码器的量化前特征, 由向量量化器隐式将回归问题转成类似 NCLM 的 token 分类; 在 Voicebox 的 flow-matching loss 之外额外加交叉熵(CE)损失提升 codec 预测精度
contributions.evaluation: RealEdit 数据集上总 WER 4.54%, 低于 VoiceCraft(5.23/5.52)、两个 Voicebox 复现(5.13/4.97), 甚至低于 Original(4.65); 主观 5 分自然度听测(15 名听者, 120 条/人)中 VoiceNoNG 与原始语音相当
contributions.domain: 语音编辑 / 语音合成
contributions.source_quote: We propose VoiceNoNG, a speech editing model that combines the strengths of both Voicebox and VoiceCraft, achieving **SOTA** performance in both objective and subjective evaluations.

contributions.purpose: 指出实现鲁棒语音编辑模型的关键组件
contributions.mechanism: 消融研究: 对比建模量化前特征 vs 量化后特征、加/不加 CE loss, 论证神经编解码器中的向量量化器(VQ)模块对预测误差提供额外鲁棒性
contributions.evaluation: 消融显示量化后(post-quantization)特征平均 WER 最高(总 4.73%), 且其主观自然度显著下降; 量化前特征 + CE loss 得到最低 WER(4.54%)
contributions.domain: 语音编辑 / 神经编解码器
contributions.source_quote: We find that the vector **quantizer** module in the neural codec is crucial for developing a robust speech editing model.

contributions.purpose: 把部分伪造(partial spoof)检测推广到更实际的场景, 并支持防御研究
contributions.mechanism: 构建区分'重合成(resynthesized)语音'与'编辑语音'的新检测设定, 用 VoiceNoNG 编辑 LibriLight 语音生成数据集(训练/验证/测试 106,186/34,744/33,974 条), 用 w2v2-detector 做检测与定位
contributions.evaluation: Table 3: 句级检测准确率接近 100%(即便 VoiceNoNG(resyn) 条件下); 但 resyn 条件的帧级 F1 低于普通 VoiceNoNG, 说明帧级区分更难; 承诺发布新数据集
contributions.source_quote: We extend the partial spoof detection setting to a more practical scenario. A new speech dataset edited by VoiceNoNG will be released to support defensive research.

self_declared_provenance.quote: our proposed editing method, VoiceNoNG, is based on the combination of these two methods [Voicebox and VoiceCraft]
In addition to the original flow-matching loss used in Voicebox, we apply a cross-entropy (CE) loss to further enhance our model's codec prediction accuracy after VQ.
Similar to VoiceCraft, we use GigaSpeech as the training corpus, as its diverse audio conditions enable our model to perform background-preserving speech editing.

notes: 方法明确是 Voicebox(flow-matching) 与 VoiceCraft(NCLM/VQ) 的融合。混合结果信号: (1) 量化后特征(post-quantization)消融是负结果——平均 WER 最高且主观自然度显著下降; (2) 深伪检测 trade-off——VoiceNoNG(resyn) 条件下帧级 F1 低于普通 VoiceNoNG, 帧级区分更难; (3) WER 提升幅度有限(总 WER 4.54 vs Voicebox(Giga) 4.97), 且作者自述整句 WER 差异被未编辑区域稀释, 编辑区域差异应更明显但未单独量化。资源(编辑数据集)为承诺发布。
